   City of South Gate
  Tweedy Mile Advisory Board
  October 09, 2025

  STAFF REPORT
  AGENDA ITEM NO. 1

 TO: Tweedy Mile Advisory Board

 FROM: Leticia Aguilar Cueto, C.E. Management Analyst, City Manager’s Office

 SUBJECT: Research on Adding Christmas Decorations Along Tweedy Mile

 PURPOSE: The purpose of this report is to present a decoration concept for enhancing the Tweedy
 Mile corridor during the holiday season. Fiscal Year 2025/26.

 RECOMMENDED ACTION: Staff recommends that the Tweedy Mile Advisory Board provide
 direction on preferred holiday decoration enhancements, including the potential purchase of additional pole-
 mounted snowflake decorations. The Board may also consider authorizing staff to move forward with vendor
 coordination, quote finalization, and implementation, with funding to be allocated from the available General
 Promotion budget.

BACKGROUND: The City Council ordered the levy and collection of assessments for Fiscal Year
2025–26 for the Parking and Business Improvement Area, also known as the Tweedy Mile Business
District, under the authority of the Parking and Business Improvement Area Law of 1989 (California
Streets and Highways Code Section 36500 et seq.).

As part of the approved budget, the City Council and the Tweedy Mile Advisory Board (TMAB)
allocated a total of $28,506.54 for FY 2025–26. Of this amount, $10,000 was designated for the
Decoration of Any Public Place in the Area, and $18,506.54 was allocated for the General Promotion
of Retail Trade Activities.

In response to direction from the TMAB, staff has conducted research on additional holiday
decorations that may be implemented in time for the upcoming season. The Board expressed interest
in enhancing the existing holiday garlands with additional festive bows or other Christmas
decorations along Tweedy Mile.

While vendor quotes are still being gathered, this report is intended to initiate the conversation and
provide the Board with an opportunity to offer input or delegate authority to staff to proceed with
vendor selection once pricing is confirmed.

Should the Board wish to move forward, funds may be allocated from the $18,506.54 currently
available under the General Promotion budget to support this effort.

 5
 Tweedy Mile Advisory Board – Holiday Lighting Expansion

FY 25/26 Budget Review
Existing Budget Commitments

• $10,000 – Storage & installation of existing garlands (committed).

• $18,506.54 – General Promotion funds (flexible for new décor/enhancements).

Selected Vendor – So Cal Lighting Pros
• 5’ Standard Snowflake Pole Mount – $585 each (+ tax & shipping).

• Already our current contractor for holiday lighting installation, storage, and removal.

• Ensures seamless integration, no new vendor contracts required.

Installation & Storage Costs (So Cal Lighting Pros)
There are two ways installation and storage can be handled:

1. Permanent Hardware Installation (Recommended)
 • Year 1: $275 per pole (covers installing the hardware, labor, and first-year storage).
 • Year 2 and onward: $150 per pole, per year (covers removal, storage, and reinstallation).
 • This option is the most cost-effective long term.

2. Hardware Removed Each Year
 • $225 per pole, per year (covers labor and storage).
 • Higher recurring cost since hardware must be removed and reinstalled every season.

Both prices include labor and storage of decorations.

Cost Scenarios – Standard Snowflake (before tax/shipping)
 Units  Purchase Cost  Install/Storage  Total Year 1  Ongoing (Year
  (Year 1)  2+)

 10  $5,850  $2,750  $8,600  $1,500/yr

 18  $10,530  $4,950  $15,480  $2,700/yr

Cost-Effectiveness
• Lowest unit cost compared to other vendors ($585 vs. $686–$895).

• Savings at scale:
  – 10 units → $1,000–$3,100 less than alternatives.
  – 18 units → $1,800–$5,500 less than alternatives.

  6
 • Long-term efficiency: Permanent hardware reduces annual storage costs by $75/pole
starting in Year 2.

• Operational advantage: So Cal Lighting Pros already maintains our garlands and skylines.

Final Recommendation
Move forward with 10 or 18 Standard 5’ Snowflake Pole Mounts from So Cal Lighting Pros.

This option:
• Expands Tweedy Mile’s holiday lighting footprint,
• Stays within available General Promotion funds,
• Leverages the existing contractor for a smooth rollout, and
• Ensures the most cost-effective long-term investment.
